translations.text: …about the child, or [?] of the Savior [?]. [?] the Lord God [?] his blessed ones, and you yourself willingly followed [?]; [?] now much speaking [?]
and the immaculate virgin, so [?] … [?] the angel, the messenger, [?] … and into her womb [?] to us [?] came almighty God.
And the virgin's son, our Lord himself, Christ, coequal in divinity with the Father always, be praying [?] that
his [?] baptism [?], mercy and grace be over us always, that he, dwelling together with God the Father, may grant us
as he has promised to all those who [?] him and love him, eternal life in his kingdom, together with him, forever. Amen.
